x: Our race started at 4pm with John Barry contesting the first 800m leg and he brought us in contention in 8th place. Everyone excelled themselves and the excitement rose as John Gladwin moved us into 2nd place on the 6th leg.

Stu Paton and Paul Richley both had bad colds but turned out to support the team effort while John Barry travelled down from Redditch. We also saw Kevin Sturman in Belgrave colours for the first time and nobody would have guessed from his styllish run that this was also to be his first race since injury in the summer.
John Barry has backed up our middle distance men this year and secured his 'B' spot in our BAL 1500m squad with some good performances.
John Gladwin cruised round the 1500 and was chased home by John Barry. Stuart Paton, Derrick William, Ken, Phil Goedluck, David North all won their events with good performances.

Admittedly a few of our 'A' team men were on view, with John Barry scoring an easy 1500 win and Abi Ekoku giving us maximum points in the Shot and Discus, but we had no 'B' competitor in two events and the selected 'B' 1500m runner didn't turn up so we were still giving away points unnecessarily.
In both cases the trips were financed by our patron Eddie Kulukundis. Congratulations to John and Jane Barry who are expecting their first child in May.
No points were left uncontested with John Barry sweeping up where there were gaps. Myles Cottrell made an exciting and fruitful debut winning the 'B' javelin in fine style.

John Barry availed himself of the 2 miles event on May 13th when he placed 6th with 10:42. A week after running the 'A' 1500 in BAL match 1 at Birmingham Steve Halliday was back on the roads for the Halifax Courier 10k.
